**Drafted 4.2.0 into `CHANGELOG.md`.** Out of 380 commits, 15 things matter.

Three break people: the `401` swap, the removed v1 export route, the dropped error-type re-exports. One new feature, eleven fixes.

Two calls to check. I left out the speed work since your three headings have no home for it. And several commits mention a minimum Node version, but nothing changed `engines`.
